## Summary

Briefly describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tests / CI only
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)

## Related issue

Fixes #NNN
Relevant issue: #NNN

## Testing

Run and confirm:

- [ ] `composer test` passes (PHPStan, Pint, Rector dry-run, Pest type-coverage at 100%, unit tests)
- [ ] `composer lint:check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior (new or updated tests)
- [ ] Manually verified in a Laravel application, if user-facing

## Checklist

- [ ] The coding style follows `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Each commit is meaningful (coherent commit history)
- [ ] Branch is rebased on `main` and free of merge conflicts
- [ ] SemVer impact considered (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] Docs / README updated for user-facing changes
